themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents capable of performing research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including planning, execution, and artifact generation.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools designed to help developers write, debug, and optimize code, often integrated into IDEs or offering standalone capabilities.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights AI-powered platforms and software specifically designed to aid researchers in gathering, analyzing, and synthesizing information.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Encompasses AI applications that condense large amounts of text into concise summaries, aiding in information digestion and quick insights.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of AI-generated personas or data that mimic human users for testing, simulation, or research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI adoption is affecting jobs, skill requirements, employment rates, and the overall nature of work.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to analyze and interpret user emotions, opinions, and attitudes from text or other forms of feedback.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in the design process, including generative design, AI-assisted prototyping, and AI for UI/UX exploration.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the use, impact, and perception of AI chatbots in various contexts, including customer service, companionship, and information retrieval.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Details AI techniques and tools used for analyzing large datasets to uncover patterns, insights, and trends.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
